# Esskay General Trading LLC
Esskay is a B2B food trading company based in Dubai, UAE, supplying dry fruits & nuts, spices, pulses & legumes, and cooking sauces & oils to hotels, restaurants, caterers, distributors, and QSR operators across the UAE and GCC.
